scope: Shared VII header world selector and global-search action

root_cause.finding: Two shared-state regressions combined. An invisible fixed backdrop intercepted the first search click while the selector was open, and the legacy cookie-banner rule body:has(.cookie-card) .world-dock moved the header-owned world control 215 CSS pixels upward when consent UI was present. The second defect made the control intermittently disappear according to each visitor's cookie state.
root_cause.public_reproduction: On version 321 with the cookie card present, the world trigger had a top coordinate of -203 CSS pixels and computed inset equivalent to a 215-pixel floating-dock offset. The search anchor remained at y=12, which explained why the problem varied between visitors.

implementation: Removed the invisible full-screen world-selector backdrop.
Changed outside closing to a document click so pointerdown cannot remove interactive state before the destination control activates.
Neutralized the legacy cookie-banner offset inside the header with inset: auto !important so the world control remains in the header for every consent state.
Kept Escape closing and restored focus to the world-selector trigger.
Made the search anchor itself the complete pointer target and enabled touch-action manipulation.
preserved_invariants: No icon, copy, route, color, spacing, header order or world data changed.
Mobile search geometry remains the approved 40x40 CSS pixels; desktop remains 44x44 CSS pixels.
Account and join routes, which intentionally omit the world selector, retain the same working global-search link.

build.notes: All routes built successfully; only the pre-existing chunk-size warning remained.

checks: Shared header search href remains localized to /search.
No world-dock backdrop remains in source or styles.
Outside pointer closing is installed and contained by the selector root.
Search touch target rules remain attached to the anchor.

observations: The search anchor was the top hit target in every checked route.
The first touch or pointer activation navigated to /search.
Backdrop count was zero in every checked route.
No checked viewport had horizontal overflow.
The public version passed all 40 checks after deployment.

states: back navigation and repeated first touch

typography_and_console.source_audit: passed for app and components; repository-root findings were limited to third-party browser-extension CSS stored inside prior QA browser profiles
typography_and_console.first_paint: Cold and warm checks at 390px and 1440px kept Rubik, Heebo, Assistant, Arial, sans-serif from the first animation frame through document.fonts.ready.

independent_seal.notes: The independent checker reviewed the exact public release, commit, HTTP response, public CSS fix and the 40-check public first-action matrix.

production_gate.public_checks: 40 of 40 exact first-action checks passed; the full sitewide automated release gate passed all four stages.
